description: Shared quantity vocabulary for the SenML readings profile of ADR-111. Each quantity name maps to exactly one SenML unit. Unknown names are accepted, stored and counted, and nothing consumes them.

units_registry.source: IANA SenML Units registry (primary units, RFC 8428) and its Secondary Units subregistry (RFC 8798)
unit_notes: Every unit string below was checked against the registry text on the checked date.
Not in either registry, so not used: ppb, breath/min.
kWh is registered only as a secondary unit and RFC 8428 advises against it; this vocabulary uses J.

quantities.name: temperature
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Air or surface temperature, degrees Celsius.

quantities.name: pressure
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Absolute air pressure. Producers that read hPa multiply by 100.

quantities.name: co2
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Carbon dioxide mole fraction in air.
quantities.notes: ppm is a secondary unit (RFC 8798). The profile allows it in u; see the ADR, section on units.

quantities.name: tvoc
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Total volatile organic compounds as a mole fraction.
quantities.notes: ppb is in neither IANA units registry. Parts-per-billion sensors divide by 1000 and write ppm. Index-style outputs (an air-quality index, a raw gas resistance) are not tvoc.

quantities.name: pm1_0
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Particulate mass concentration, particles up to 1.0 um.

quantities.name: pm2_5
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Particulate mass concentration, particles up to 2.5 um.

quantities.name: pm10
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Particulate mass concentration, particles up to 10 um.

quantities.name: sound_level
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Sound pressure level in decibels re 20 uPa.
quantities.notes: The registry's dB is the generic logarithmic ratio and names no reference. This vocabulary fixes the reference at 20 uPa. Bspl (bels) is registered but is not used. A weighting (A or C) belongs in the producer's source documentation, not in the unit.

quantities.name: contact
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Contact state. true = contact closed (door shut, switch made), false = open.
quantities.notes: Boolean quantity: uses vb and carries no unit.

quantities.name: power
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.description: Instantaneous electrical power. Negative is export.

quantities.name: energy
quantities.subject: space-or-object
quantities.notes: Joules are the registered primary unit. Wh and kWh exist only as secondary units; producers convert (1 Wh = 3600 J).

quantities.name: respiration_rate
quantities.subject: person-track-only
quantities.description: Respiration rate of one person, breaths per minute.
quantities.notes: breath/min is not in the IANA registry. 1/min (event rate) is the registered primary unit for a per-minute count.

cues.meaning: A door or lid was opened, which implies a person may have acted near it.

vector.description: closed then open fires once; closed then closed does not

cues.meaning: An appliance started drawing power, such as a stove or kettle.

vector.description: a 1.8 kW rise within 4 s fires; a 20 W drift does not

cues.meaning: Carbon dioxide rising in a closed room implies occupants are breathing in it.

vector.description: a 200 ppm rise in 240 s fires; a 20 ppm rise does not
a temperature reading routes to calibration, never to the person estimate
a humidity reading routes to calibration
a door contact change routes to domain-state checks as a covariate
